overall.verdict: The mobile-dark variant demonstrates strong execution of the xln wallet's core value propositions with excellent visceral value visualization and trust-building elements. The design successfully implements the one-scale bar principle and provides clear provable payment confirmations. However, there are opportunities to improve typography hierarchy and reduce visual noise in several screens.
